title: 2014 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: Four children were born at City Hospital yesterday. Assume each child is equally likely to be a boy or a girl. Which of the following outcomes is most likely?

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text:
\(3\) are of one gender and \(1\) is of the
other gender

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: all of these outcomes are equally likely

solutions.text:
There are \(2^4=16\) equally likely birth-order outcomes. The counts by category are: all boys, \(1\); all girls, \(1\); two boys and two girls, \(\binom{4}{2}=6\); and three of one gender and one of the other, \(2\binom{4}{1}=8\).

The largest count is \(8\), so the most likely outcome is three children of one gender and one of the other.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: List outcomes by the number of boys and girls.
The most likely category is the one with the most arrangements.
